# WhatsApp
> Secure, reliable private messaging and calling across phones and devices, with consumer, business, and developer resources.

WhatsApp provides end-to-end encrypted messaging, voice and video calling, group communication, status updates, channels, desktop and mobile apps, and business messaging tools. This file highlights the main product, support, business, and developer resources across WhatsApp properties.

## Product Overview
- [Home](https://www.whatsapp.com/): Main product overview for WhatsApp messaging, calling, privacy, and cross-platform communication.
- [Download](https://www.whatsapp.com/download): Download WhatsApp for Android, iPhone, Mac, Windows, and other supported platforms.
- [Calling](https://www.whatsapp.com/calling): Overview of private voice and video calling features across devices.
- [Messaging](https://www.whatsapp.com/messaging): Overview of simple, secure messaging features and communication capabilities.
- [Groups](https://www.whatsapp.com/groups): Information about WhatsApp group conversations, coordination, and shared communication.
- [Status](https://www.whatsapp.com/status): Overview of disappearing status updates for sharing photos, videos, and text.
- [Channels](https://www.whatsapp.com/channels): Information about one-way broadcast channels for updates from people and organizations.
- [Meta AI](https://www.whatsapp.com/meta-ai): Overview of Meta AI experiences available within WhatsApp.

## Privacy and Security
- [Security](https://www.whatsapp.com/security): Security overview including end-to-end encryption and account protection information.
- [Privacy](https://www.whatsapp.com/privacy): Privacy information, controls, and explanations of how WhatsApp handles user data.
- [Help Center](https://faq.whatsapp.com/): Official support site with troubleshooting, account, privacy, and feature guidance.
- [Safety Center](https://www.whatsapp.com/stayconnected): Safety-focused guidance for secure and responsible communication on WhatsApp.

## Apps and Platforms
- [Download](https://www.whatsapp.com/download): Central download page for mobile, desktop, and device-specific WhatsApp apps.
- [WhatsApp Web](https://web.whatsapp.com/): Browser-based access to WhatsApp linked from a primary mobile account.
- [WhatsApp for Android](https://www.whatsapp.com/android): Android app information and installation entry point.
- [WhatsApp for iPhone](https://www.whatsapp.com/iphone): iPhone app information and installation entry point.
- [WhatsApp for Mac](https://www.whatsapp.com/download): Desktop app download information for macOS systems.
- [WhatsApp for Windows](https://www.whatsapp.com/download): Desktop app download information for Windows systems.

## Help Center
- [WhatsApp Help Center](https://faq.whatsapp.com/): Main support portal for account, app, and feature help articles.
- [About WhatsApp Web and Desktop](https://faq.whatsapp.com/web): Help articles for using WhatsApp Web and desktop apps.
- [Account and Profile](https://faq.whatsapp.com/general/account-and-profile): Support articles for account setup, profile, and registration issues.
- [Chats](https://faq.whatsapp.com/general/chats): Help articles covering chats, media, backups, and messaging behavior.
- [Voice and Video Calls](https://faq.whatsapp.com/general/voice-and-video-calls): Support guidance for calling setup, quality, and troubleshooting.
- [Privacy and Security](https://faq.whatsapp.com/general/security-and-privacy): Help articles about privacy settings, safety, and account security.
- [Communities and Groups](https://faq.whatsapp.com/general/groups): Support content for groups, communities, and participant management.

## Blog and Updates
- [WhatsApp Blog](https://blog.whatsapp.com/): Official announcements, feature launches, product updates, and company news.
- [Privacy and Security News](https://blog.whatsapp.com/topics/privacy-and-security): Blog posts focused on privacy, safety, and security updates.
- [Product News](https://blog.whatsapp.com/): Official product announcements and feature release information.
- [Business News](https://blog.whatsapp.com/): Updates related to WhatsApp Business products and messaging capabilities.

## Business Products
- [WhatsApp Business](https://business.whatsapp.com/): Overview of WhatsApp solutions for businesses communicating with customers.
- [WhatsApp Business App](https://business.whatsapp.com/products/business-app): Information about the small-business app for customer messaging.
- [WhatsApp Business Platform](https://business.whatsapp.com/products/platform): Overview of the platform for scalable customer conversations.
- [Success Stories](https://business.whatsapp.com/resources/success-stories): Case studies showing how businesses use WhatsApp to engage customers.
- [Business Resources](https://business.whatsapp.com/resources): Guides, playbooks, and educational materials for business messaging.
- [Business Help Center](https://business.whatsapp.com/help): Support resources for WhatsApp Business products.

## Business Platform Documentation
- [Developer Documentation](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp): Official documentation for building on the WhatsApp Business Platform.
- [Cloud API](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api): Reference and guides for the hosted WhatsApp Cloud API.
- [On-Premises API](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/on-premises): Documentation for self-hosted WhatsApp Business API deployments.
- [Embedded Signup](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/embedded-signup): Setup guidance for onboarding businesses to the platform.
- [Business Management API](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/business-management-api): API documentation for managing WhatsApp business assets and configuration.
- [Webhooks](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api/webhooks): Event delivery documentation for receiving message and account updates.
- [Reference](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api/reference): Endpoint reference for WhatsApp Cloud API operations.

## Developer Guides
- [Get Started](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/getting-started): Introductory guide for setting up and using WhatsApp developer tools.
- [Send Messages](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api/guides/send-messages): Guide for sending text and media messages with the Cloud API.
- [Receive Messages](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api/guides/set-up-webhooks): Guide for configuring webhooks to receive inbound messages and events.
- [Media Messages](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api/guides/send-messages#media-messages): Guidance for sending images, audio, video, and documents.
- [Message Templates](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/business-management-api/message-templates): Documentation for creating and managing approved message templates.
- [Authentication](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/system-users): Guidance for access tokens, system users, and app authentication.
- [Rate Limits and Throughput](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api/overview#throughput): Information about messaging throughput and platform limits.

## Policies and Legal
- [Terms of Service](https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service): Legal terms governing use of WhatsApp consumer services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy): Legal privacy policy for WhatsApp services.
- [Business Terms](https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/business-terms): Terms applicable to WhatsApp business products and services.
- [Commerce Policy](https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/commerce-policy): Rules governing commerce-related activity on WhatsApp.
- [Acceptable Use of Business Services](https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/business-policy): Policy requirements for using WhatsApp business services.
- [Intellectual Property Policy](https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/intellectual-property-policy): Policy information for trademarks, copyright, and intellectual property matters.
